record.question: According to recommendations of 12th National Conference on Safety in Mines, the permissible respirable dust levels be brought down to .......mg/m3 (In case percentage of free silica content up to 5) or divided by percentage of free silica content in dust, from the present level, in line of prescribed limits of NIOSH, USA.
record.explanation: NIOSH/MSHA respirable dust limit is 2 mg/m³ when free silica is up to 5%, otherwise 10 divided by the percentage of free silica.
